# ClassroomTimers

> Free browser-based classroom timers and clocks for teaching, presenting, and focused learning. No account or download required. Timing uses timestamps for accuracy when tabs are backgrounded; preferences stay in the browser locally.

Site: [https://classroomtimers.app](https://classroomtimers.app)  
Contact: [hello@classroomtimers.app](mailto:hello@classroomtimers.app)

Languages: English (default at `/`), [Simplified Chinese](https://classroomtimers.app/zh) (`/zh`), [Traditional Chinese](https://classroomtimers.app/zh-hant) (`/zh-hant`), [Japanese](https://classroomtimers.app/ja) (`/ja`), [Spanish](https://classroomtimers.app/es) (`/es`), [Brazilian Portuguese](https://classroomtimers.app/pt-br) (`/pt-br`), [French](https://classroomtimers.app/fr) (`/fr`). Localized pages use the same path after the locale prefix, for example [10 minute timer (français)](https://classroomtimers.app/fr/timer/10-minute-timer).

## Primary tools

- [Classroom Timer](https://classroomtimers.app/): Large countdown for projectors and classroom screens with presets, full screen, wake lock, and clear finish warning.
- [World Clock](https://classroomtimers.app/world-clock): Live day-night map and multi-city local times with UTC offsets and DST.
- [Flip Clock](https://classroomtimers.app/flip-clock): Full-screen flip-style clock with optional seconds, date, styles, and backgrounds.
- [Digital Clock](https://classroomtimers.app/digital-clock): Full-screen digital clock with optional seconds, day/date, styles, and backgrounds.
- [Stopwatch](https://classroomtimers.app/stopwatch): Elapsed-time stopwatch with laps, adjustable precision, full screen, and wake lock.
- [Multiple Timers Online](https://classroomtimers.app/timer/multiple-timers): Independent countdowns and stopwatches in one workspace, with repeat countdowns, colors, alarms, and batch controls. Displays 6 cards per page in a fixed 3-by-2 desktop layout; other pages keep timing. Configurations are saved in the current browser when storage is available; reloading resets the session. Keep the page open and the device awake because suspended tabs can delay alarms.
- [Interval Timer](https://classroomtimers.app/timer/interval-timer): Custom work and rest durations, 1–99 rounds, warm-up, cool-down, alerts, phase navigation, and full screen.
- [HIIT Timer](https://classroomtimers.app/timer/hiit-timer): High-intensity and recovery timer with editable 40/20, 30/15, and 45/15 presets, round tracking, warnings, and full screen.
- [Tabata Timer](https://classroomtimers.app/timer/tabata-timer): Classic 20 seconds work, 10 seconds rest, and 8 rounds, plus beginner and extended presets, alerts, and full screen.
- [Exam Timer](https://classroomtimers.app/timer/exam-timer): Multi-section exam countdown with SAT, GRE, IELTS, and custom presets.
- [SAT Timer](https://classroomtimers.app/timer/sat-timer): Editable four-module digital SAT practice countdown for Reading and Writing and Math.
- [GRE Timer](https://classroomtimers.app/timer/gre-timer): Current GRE General Test practice countdown for Analytical Writing, Verbal, and Quantitative sections.
- [IELTS Timer](https://classroomtimers.app/timer/ielts-timer): IELTS Academic practice countdown for Listening, Reading, and Writing sections.

## Classroom timer duration presets

- [1 minute timer](https://classroomtimers.app/timer/1-minute-timer): Quiet transition or final-check countdown.
- [2 minute timer](https://classroomtimers.app/timer/2-minute-timer): Tidy-up, materials, or quick recap countdown.
- [3 minute timer](https://classroomtimers.app/timer/3-minute-timer): Group rotation or short classroom task countdown.
- [5 minute timer](https://classroomtimers.app/timer/5-minute-timer): Quick classroom activity or transition countdown.
- [10 minute timer](https://classroomtimers.app/timer/10-minute-timer): Short practice, discussion, or break block.
- [15 minute timer](https://classroomtimers.app/timer/15-minute-timer): Common independent work or station rotation length.
- [20 minute timer](https://classroomtimers.app/timer/20-minute-timer): Extended activity or reading block.
- [25 minute timer](https://classroomtimers.app/timer/25-minute-timer): Pomodoro-style focus session length.
- [30 minute timer](https://classroomtimers.app/timer/30-minute-timer): Lesson block, sustained reading, or short quiz countdown.
- [45 minute timer](https://classroomtimers.app/timer/45-minute-timer): Typical class period or exam section length.
- [60 minute timer](https://classroomtimers.app/timer/60-minute-timer): Full-hour session or long-form activity countdown.

## Secondary visual timers

- [Rocket Timer](https://classroomtimers.app/timer/rocket-timer): Rising rocket countdown with a flame trail, pause and reset, and a colorful finish at zero.
- [Fireworks Timer](https://classroomtimers.app/timer/fireworks-timer): Burning firecracker fuse synchronized with the countdown and a short fireworks show at zero.

- [Visual Timer](https://classroomtimers.app/timer/visual-timer): Shrinking color disc or horizontal fill bar with an exact synchronized countdown.
- [Egg Timer](https://classroomtimers.app/timer/egg-timer): Visual countdown with 3, 6, and 9 minute cooking presets plus custom time.
- [Candle Timer](https://classroomtimers.app/timer/candle-timer): Candle-burn visual countdown with readable numeric time.
